shipped_round3.note: The model the pipeline actually shipped, scored directly. Identical to round 4: it matches known-WRONG RTL on 27 testpoints and golden on 18, so the separation inverts. refmodel_gate.json recorded 0 issues and the per-requirement judge returned 'met' on 77 of 77 requirements for this file.

reference_model.verdict: DEFECTIVE, and vacuous from round 1 onward. The shipped model returns a single constant output state, so it scores HIGHER against known-wrong RTL than against golden -- the separation inverts.

per_round_liveness.measured_with: specflow.refmodel.compose.render on agent_io/refmodel_r{N}_response.txt, driven through default_stimulus (64 corner-first vectors)
per_round_liveness.finding: The repair loop made it inert at the FIRST repair round and it never recovered. The model did not start vacuous -- per-requirement judging drove it there, and reported met on 77 of 77 requirements for every inert round.

gates_that_passed_it.why: Both compare the model against the SPECIFICATION. Neither requires the model's outputs to ever move, and the spec's own summary clause licenses the filter defect: 'ena: Core enable signal. It gates normal timing/filter operation.' Golden implements the precise clause that follows -- the filter COUNTER is reset -- which makes the filter run every cycle rather than stop.
gates_that_passed_it.fix: specflow/refmodel/validate.py now reports a model whose outputs never move across a corner-first sweep. It clears round 0 and flags rounds 1-4, with zero false positives on the three known-correct models in this repo.

localisation.method: benchmarks/divergence_trace.py, three-way (DUT / 181-181 control / generated) on TP-0006
localisation.finding: the generated model's sSCL and sSDA never move; both the DUT and the control drop them at edge 1 and restore at edge 4
localisation.cause_in_source: _update_filter takes `if not ena:` and skips the filter shift entirely

repairs_attempted.what: ONLY the ena gating, phase left alone

localisation.conclusion: NOT point-localisable. Both repairs made the model match the wrong RTL better than golden, so the phase convention is load-bearing across every downstream stage. This is a different failure mode from the control oracle's two bugs, which were one line each and independently repairable (113 -> 159 -> 168).
